summary: Chicago Atlantic Real Estate Finance issued 4,306,754 shares (16.8% of post-issuance outstanding) at $14.53/share to Koach entities in exchange for $62.5M second-lien promissory notes secured by 32 cannabis properties. Notes bear 12% interest (10% cash, 2% PIK) with a 12-year weighted maturity and a 2.5x exit fee. The transaction is a private placement of equity for debt, not a standard special situation; no adviser mentioned. The lock-up restricts sales for 3-6 months. What to watch: credit performance of the underlying cannabis loans and potential dilution impact on shareholders.
